sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.6033 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/Accused No.1, under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C."), to quash the proceedings in Crime No.325 of 2019 pending on the file of Koilakuntla Police Station, Kurnool District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 328, 272, 273, 188 r/w 34 IPC and Sections 58, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this Criminal Petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel, miscellaneous applications pending, if any,
shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

_ _ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY December 31, 2020 LMV THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION NO.6033 OF 2020 December 31, 2020 LMV Soma Kalyan vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 31 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179939249/
